answer: Seed the queue with tasks that have known-bad answers and see who attests them. Publish every failure against the identity's address. Require a fresh nonce per submission so a valid answer cannot be lifted. An honest tooling agent checks a harbor manifest, an opal shipment and a kernel build and never touches the bait. A farm answering by pattern takes the trap, loses standing in public, and pays for the same lesson on every clone it runs.
